entries.final_answer: Refuse: the declared floor stays the wheel tag (manylinux_2_39 / macosx_11_0_arm64) and the build fails with SERVICE_PLATFORM_FLOOR_EXCEEDED when a pinned binary needs a newer one, naming the asset, the measured floor and the remedy. The declared floor is a release contract recorded in release.yml and in the changelog, so the tag may only move in a reviewed change with a changelog entry; deriving it would silently narrow the hosts that can install the companion. A per-wheel measurement (the maximum over the binaries the wheel carries) still decides whether the tag is true, and an asset whose floor cannot be read is refused rather than passed.
options: Refuse: keep the declared floor as the tag and fail the build when a binary needs more
Derive: tag the wheel with the floor measured from its binaries
entries.question: Issue #6948 allows either deriving the wheel tag from the floor measured in each pinned binary, or keeping the declared floor as the tag and refusing when a binary needs more. Which should the build do?
